description: Parse a semantic version into major, minor, patch, prerelease and build parts; compare two versions by precedence including prerelease ordering; or test whether a version satisfies a range expression using caret, tilde, hyphen, x-ranges and comparator sets. Returns the parsed structure, the comparison result and the reason a range did not match. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

a.description: First version for op=compare. Accepted: at most 256 characters.

b.description: Second version for op=compare. Accepted: at most 256 characters.

op.description: parse (default), compare, satisfies or sort. Accepted: parse, compare, satisfies, sort.

range.description: Range expression for op=satisfies, e.g. ^1.2.0. Accepted: at most 256 characters.

version.description: Version to parse (op=parse) or test (op=satisfies). Accepted: at most 256 characters.

versions.description: Comma-separated versions for op=sort, at most 100. Accepted: at most 100 versions.

name: code_semver
title: Semantic-version parse, compare, and range satisfaction
